SELECT hcla.document_name, hcla.description, hcla.chance_attachment_id, hcla.chance_id, (select wm_concat(fa.attachment_id) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' and hcla.chance_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) attachment_id, (select wm_concat(fa.file_name) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' and hcla.chance_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) file_name, (select max(fa.creation_date) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' and hcla.chance_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) upload_date, (select max(su.description) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam ,sys_user su where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' and hcla.chance_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value and su.user_id = fa.created_by) upload_person FROM hls_credit_line_attach hcla
where hcla.chance_id = #{chanceId}

SELECT hcla.CHANCE_ATTACHMENT_ID, hcla.document_name, ( SELECT LISTAGG ( file_name, ',' ) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY file_name ) AS document_name FROM fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam, fnd_atm_attachment fat WHERE hcla.chance_attachment_id = faam.table_pk_value AND faam.attachment_id = fat.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_ATTACH' AND hcla.attachment_category = 'CHANCE_ATT' ) info_name, hcla.created_by, ( SELECT description FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = hcla.created_by ) created_by_n, hcla.creation_date, hcla.description, ( SELECT count( 1 ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment faa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE faam.attachment_id = faa.attachment_id AND faam.table_pk_value = hcla.chance_attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_ATTACH' ) file_num FROM hls_credit_line_attach hcla
hcla.chance_id = #{chanceId}

SELECT fat.file_name, fat.file_path FROM HLS_CREDIT_LINE_ATTACH hcla, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam, fnd_atm_attachment fat WHERE hcla.chance_attachment_id = faam.table_pk_value AND faam.attachment_id = fat.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_ATTACH' AND hcla.attachment_category = #{attachmentCategory} and hcla.chance_id = #{chanceId}
